prompt: Write a program that takes an index as a command-line argument, followed by additional arguments. The program should print the argument at the specified index from the additional arguments (where index 0 refers to the first additional argument, index 1 to the second, etc.). The program should handle invalid indices safely (e.g., negative indices, indices out of bounds) and should not crash or exhibit undefined behavior.
implementation_details: Language: C. Use C language. Parse argv[1] as the index. Access arguments from argv[2] onwards, where index 0 maps to argv[2], index 1 to argv[3], etc.
